slides.alt: A plate of oven salmon with lemon and rosemary on a woven placemat, with the text: This meal turned out to be delicious.
A plate with salmon, lemon and creamy carrot risotto, with the text: I made the risotto with a few carrots, some butter and, most importantly, parmesan at the end.
A half eaten piece of salmon with flaked pieces and lemon on a white plate, with the text: I loved the salmon, but I kept going back for more risotto.
A slice of chocolate coconut cake topped with sour cherry compote on a white plate, with the text: The chocolate and coconut cake deserved a layer of peanut butter and Romanian sour cherry compote.
